description: Your Claude Code and Codex limits, sessions, agents and token use side by side, with a pace forecast. Local only.
view.name: Limits & sessions
config.channelFolder: Optional. By default the panel uses `.twingauge/channel` in an open workspace folder (see **TwinGauge: Create agent channel**). Set this to use another folder with `claude/` and `codex/` sub-folders. Relative paths start from the first workspace folder.
untrusted: In Restricted Mode the agent channel folder setting is ignored; everything else works, since TwinGauge only reads its own files in your home folder.
cmd.createChannel: TwinGauge: Create agent channel in this workspace
